about.headline: Engineering Scalable Software & Practical AI Solutions
paragraphs: I am a Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) Computer Science and Engineering student dedicated to transforming computational concepts into reliable, user-friendly software applications.

My primary development toolkit centers on Python, modern web frameworks like Flask and FastAPI, and database management systems including SQLite, MySQL, and MongoDB. I have a deep curiosity for Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing, exploring how intelligent models can simplify complex information discovery.

Beyond standard academic coursework, I actively build end-to-end projects, compete in hackathons, and innovate practical solutions for community safety, environmental sustainability, and process automation.

I believe in continuous learning, clean code architecture, and disciplined engineering practices. Currently, I am seeking opportunities to contribute to high-impact software engineering teams through technical internships and collaborative projects.

projects.title: AI-Powered College Chatbot
projects.problem: College students and prospective applicants frequently struggle with navigating sprawling institutional websites to find critical details about admissions, course curricula, faculty contacts, fee structures, and event schedules.
projects.solution: Built an interactive conversational interface utilizing sentence-transformers and semantic search embeddings to quickly parse inquiries, accurately match student questions against structured institutional datasets, and generate natural answers.
features: Dynamic query parsing and natural conversational response generation
Semantic vector similarity matching over structured college knowledge base
Real-time institutional information retrieval for departments, courses, and fees
Lightweight, accessible web interface built with Streamlit for rapid interaction
Extensible JSON and CSV knowledge base structure for quick administrative updates

projects.title: Citizen Safety & Travel Assistance Network
projects.problem: Travelers and everyday citizens often lack a unified, secure emergency assistance platform capable of generating verified digital identity credentials, dispatching geofenced safety alerts, and connecting with local emergency responders.
projects.solution: Designed a centralized Flask web platform featuring authenticated citizen digital identity, real-time geofenced incident notifications, emergency contact dispatch triggers, and a comprehensive administrative dashboard for crisis management.
features: Secure citizen digital identity management with protected profile records
One-touch emergency support triggering alerts to designated emergency contacts
Geofence-based regional safety warnings notifying users of high-risk zones
Administrative dashboard for incident triage, system logs, and user verification
Responsive, mobile-optimized interface for quick emergency access on smartphones

projects.title: Alcohol Quota Regulation System
projects.problem: Unregulated retail distribution and lack of automated quota management lead to black-market resale, purchase cap violations, and a lack of transparency for regulatory authorities.
projects.solution: Engineered an automated quota monitoring system that validates user legal age eligibility, tracks individual monthly purchasing caps across vendors, registers transactions, and supplies an administrative oversight portal.
features: Strict user registration with verified date-of-birth and eligibility screening
Dynamic monthly purchase quota tracking with real-time balance reduction
Tamper-resistant transaction logging across multi-outlet distribution points
Vendor point-of-sale interface for rapid buyer verification before checkout
Comprehensive administrative dashboard for quota adjustments and compliance auditing

projects.title: Plastic Waste Management System
projects.problem: Municipalities and recycling centers struggle with low citizen participation, decentralized collection points, and inefficient manual tracking of plastic waste streams.
projects.solution: Developed a dedicated waste management and recycling portal enabling citizens to schedule drop-offs, track collected plastic volumes, receive recycling incentives, and empower administrators to monitor logistics.
features: Citizen portal for logging domestic plastic deposits and scheduling collections
Category-wise plastic tracking (PET, HDPE, PVC, LDPE, PP, PS) for precise recycling
Recycling credit and citizen reward points system to incentivize waste segregation
Logistics and collection depot tracking for municipal recycling contractors
Real-time administrative analytics displaying total tonnage collected and processed

projects.title: Online Food Ordering System
projects.problem: Small eateries and campus cafeterias require straightforward, dependable order-taking and cart management software without exorbitant commercial platform fees or complex hardware.
projects.solution: Built an Object-Oriented Python ordering application backed by SQLite, providing robust user session management, dynamic menu browsing, real-time cart calculations, and persistent order archiving.
features: Modular OOP structure with clean class hierarchies for Users, Items, Carts, and Orders
User authentication and session security for customers and kitchen staff
Interactive menu browsing with item availability toggling and category filtering
Persistent cart calculation, tax estimation, and checkout summary generation
Structured SQLite transactional storage ensuring ACID compliance for every placed order

steps.problem: Vulnerable travelers in unfamiliar zones lack prompt emergency broadcast networks with verified identity credentials.
steps.idea: A unified digital safety companion integrating geofenced perimeter alerts with one-tap emergency beacon dispatch.
steps.technology: Python, Flask microservice architecture, SQLite geolocation indices, responsive mobile UI.
steps.prototype: Functional multi-tier web application featuring real-time geofence violation triggers and automated emergency alert dispatch.
steps.impact: Demonstrated reduced response coordination overhead and established a repeatable blueprint for campus and municipal safety systems.

hackathons_innovation.title: Campus Intelligence: Natural Language Information Retrieval

steps.problem: New university students endure significant friction retrieving authoritative answers on exams, policies, and schedules.
steps.idea: A domain-trained conversational assistant indexing unstructured university PDFs and structured departmental records.
steps.technology: Python, Sentence Transformers, Cosine Similarity search, Streamlit frontend.
steps.prototype: Working chatbot accepting free-form English queries and outputting accurate, referenced administrative answers.
steps.impact: Eliminates repetitive manual queries for administrative staff while delivering 24/7 instant guidance to student cohorts.
